_about: The announcement reel under the main nav bar, on every page (partials/header.njk). One item shows at a time; with more than one they take turns. An item disappears on its hideFrom date (Vietnam time): the build leaves it out, and a short script in the header removes it from pages built before that day. Leave `url` out for an item that links nowhere.

items.text: Campus opens Thursday 15 October, with the Quarter 1 Showcase that afternoon

vi.text: Trung tâm mở cửa lại vào thứ Năm, 15/10, và chiều hôm đó có buổi Showcase Quý 1
